profile_text.body:
Fliki is an AI video generation platform that describes itself as a tool for turning text, scripts, blog posts, and presentations into finished videos without a camera or editing skills. The service supports over 2,000 AI voices across 80 or more languages and dialects, and the company says it is used by more than 12 million creators, professionals, and teams to produce content for TikTok, YouTube, Reels, and other platforms.

The platform's core features include text-to-video generation, blog-to-video conversion, PowerPoint and Google Slides narration, AI avatar and digital twin creation, voice cloning from a short audio sample, video translation and dubbing, thumbnail creation, and screen recording. Fliki describes its voice cloning as working across 70 or more languages. The site states that the underlying models are drawn from providers including OpenAI, Google, Kling, Bytedance, and ElevenLabs, integrated into a single interface.

The held facts confirm Fliki maintains a tracked product page under the video generation and editing category. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
